jobs.title: Software Engineer AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$400-US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$400-US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Our clearinghouse product and customer-first approach have set us apart. Stedi was ranked by Ramp as one of the fastest-growing SaaS vendors. To see what we ship, watch the 2026 Stedi Keynote . To learn more about how we work, watch our founder Zack's interview with First Round Capital . What weâre looking for Stedi is hiring a Legal Engineering Counsel to build how our legal work gets done, and to own a large share of it. Every new customer, payer connection, and partnership runs through a contract, and the volume grows every month. Youâll design the systems that handle it (playbooks, review workflows, automation, and AI tooling) and run them on live deals with counterparties ranging from fast-moving healthtech startups to national payers. This role pairs legal practice with technical skill. You bring strong legal training and a feel for how commercial deals work, and youâve used AI and other technology to make legal work faster and more consistent. What you learn on live deals shapes the systems, and better systems make the next deal faster. Youâll join a small, effective Legal team with a broad mandate. We keep up with a fast-growing, highly regulated business by investing in good systems and tools, and this role sits at the center of that investment. Healthcare experience is not required â we value strong judgment, curiosity, and the ability to learn a new industry quickly. If you have the talent and drive to help build a world-class legal function alongside Stediâs experienced legal counsel mentors at a rapidly scaling tech company, we want to talk. What youâll do Build and own the systems behind Stediâs contracting, including playbooks, clause libraries, templates, intake and approval workflows, and AI-assisted first-pass review. Break recurring legal work into repeatable steps with clear inputs, decision points, and escalation paths, then decide what to automate, what to standardize, and what needs a lawyer. jobs.description: We're looking for an experienced Agile Program Manager to lead delivery across multiple cross-functional teams working toward a shared set of business outcomes. You'll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution: translating roadmap priorities into coordinated, predictable delivery, keeping dependencies visible, and making sure the right people are making the right decisions at the right time. This is a hands-on program role, not a status-reporting one. You'll own the cadence, the plan, and the risks across several Agile teams, and you'll be the person stakeholders trust to tell them where things really stand. What You'll Do Lead end-to-end delivery of a multi-team program, coordinating three or more Agile teams (Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid) toward shared quarterly objectives. Run program-level planning, including quarterly/PI planning, roadmap alignment, capacity planning, and release planning. Identify, map, and actively manage cross-team dependencies, risks, and blockers, escalating early and with clear options. Facilitate program ceremonies such as Scrum of Scrums, program syncs, system demos, and retrospectives, and make sure they produce decisions, not just updates. Partner with Product Owners and Product Managers to keep backlogs prioritized, refined, and aligned to business value. Build and maintain program-level reporting: delivery health, burn-up/velocity trends, OKR or objective progress, and RAID logs, tailored for both team-level and executive audiences. Drive continuous improvement in delivery practices, tooling, and team workflows, coaching teams and leaders on Agile principles where needed. Manage stakeholder communication across engineering, product, design, business, and leadership, keeping expectations aligned as scope and priorities shift. ð Build the data layer AI needs to do science

Application deadline: 16 Nov 2026 23:59 CET

About Claims

AI ate the Internet, but it can't digest science yet. A paper is thousands of words of prose written for humans, but an AI agent doing research needs to know what was claimed, what evidence supports it, and how far to trust it. Claims turns the scientific literature into exactly that: every claim, tied to its evidence, as structured data that models and agents can query.

We're a startup and run as Subnet 111 on Bittensor. Since our mainnet launch on 28 August 2026, an open competition of miners has processed more than 10,000 papers, and every record was checked by our validator before it entered the dataset. The competition keeps raising the bar: miners keep finding ways to beat our own reference pipeline, and every win becomes part of the standard the whole network is scored against.

The team

Claims was founded by two professors of economics and a senior engineer.

  • Philipp Koellinger, CEO, is a professor of economics and an experienced entrepreneur: founder of DeSci Labs and the DeSci Foundation, and co-builder of SciWeave with Ogban.
  • Christian Roessler, co-founder, is a professor of economics and game theorist. He designs the incentive mechanism that makes the miner competition work.
  • Ogban Ugot, engineering, is a senior backend and machine learning engineer. He built SciWeave, the Claims miner, validator and data pipeline, and you will work with him every day.

You would be the fourth person on the team and our second engineer.

Our culture

We are a fully remote team spread across Europe, Africa and the US West Coast. We have a flat hierarchy and move fast towards clearly defined goals. We think deep, don't shy away from difficult problems or conversations, and we ship relentlessly. The code you will write will run on a live network within your first weeks, and you own real things from day one. We are an AI-native company and expect you to be an AI-native Software Engineer we can trust.

About the role

Position: Software Engineer (Python, full-stack)
Location: Remote. You need to be able to join our team meetings in the afternoon, Central European Time.
Type: Full-time contractor. Start in December 2026 or January 2027.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to help maintain and build Claims and its supporting applications, services, and developer tools. Claims turns scientific research into structured claims and supporting evidence through document processing, AI pipelines, and automated evaluation.

This is a hands-on, backend-focused full-stack role. You'll work across Python services, web dashboards, data pipelines, integrations, and deployment tooling. Your work will combine delivering new features with debugging existing systems, improving reliability, and making the codebase easier to maintain.

You should be comfortable owning well-defined tasks from investigation through implementation, testing, and release, working with the team on larger design decisions and unfamiliar areas.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain Python backend services, APIs, command-line tools, and background processing workflows.
  • Develop and improve web dashboards and internal review tools using TypeScript, React, and modern web frameworks.
  • Maintain pipelines that ingest research papers, process documents, extract structured information, and evaluate results.
  • Integrate external APIs and AI model providers, handling validation, retries, timeouts, rate limits, and usage costs.
  • Work with relational databases and object storage, including schema changes, migrations, queries, and data integrity checks.
  • Investigate bugs and production issues across services, pipelines, and interfaces; address root causes and add useful regression coverage.
  • Help maintain deployment automation, continuous integration, logging, monitoring, and operational documentation.
  • Improve existing code through practical refactoring, dependency maintenance, automated tests, and code review.
  • Collaborate with engineering and research colleagues to turn requirements and experimental workflows into reliable software.

Required skills and experience

  • Typically 1â5 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience delivering and maintaining production software.
  • Strong Python skills, including building maintainable services or data processing applications, managing dependencies, and writing automated tests.
  • Experience designing, consuming, and troubleshooting HTTP APIs, with a sound understanding of JSON, validation, authentication, and error handling.
  • Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript and experience contributing to React applications or a comparable modern frontend framework.
  • Practical SQL and relational database experience, including data modelling, migrations, and debugging queries.
  • Confidence working in Linux environments and using the command line to investigate logs, configuration, processes, and service failures.
  • Experience with Git, pull requests, code review, automated testing, and continuous integration.
  • An understanding of secure engineering practices, including access controls, secrets management, and careful handling of private data.
  • The ability to navigate an existing codebase, trace issues across components, and make focused, well-tested changes.
  • Clear communication, practical problem-solving, and the judgment to work independently while asking for input when requirements or risks are unclear.

Nice to have

  • Experience with FastAPI, Pydantic, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Next.js, or similar tools.
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs, building AI-assisted workflows, or evaluating model outputs for accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost.
  • Familiarity with PDF parsing, OCR, document extraction, scientific datasets, or evidence provenance.
  • Experience with distributed jobs, asynchronous processing, reproducible pipelines, or automated benchmarking.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Ansible, systemd, GitHub Actions, cloud hosting, or infrastructure automation.
  • Experience with Bittensor, decentralized compute networks, or systems for evaluating independently submitted code.
  • Exposure to Rust, native Python extensions, or WebAssembly.
  • An interest in scientific research, open-source software, and tools that make research easier to inspect and reuse.

You don't need experience with every technology listed. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly across the stack matter most.

What success looks like

  • You can independently deliver scoped features and fixes across the backend and supporting web applications.
  • Your changes are understandable, tested, and documented, with appropriate attention to security and compatibility.
  • You help make processing pipelines and production services more reliable and easier to troubleshoot.
  • You contribute constructively to reviews, communicate progress and blockers, and help the team turn research ideas into maintainable software.

What we offer

  • $1500 - $2000 per month, depending on experience.
  • Opportunities for rapid professional growth in a high-impact role: a small team, a live network, and a senior engineer to learn from.
  • Quarterly team retreats in inspiring locations (e.g., Vilnius, Koh Samui).
  • Travel and visa support for business needs.
  • Flexible remote working.


Help us build the data layer that lets AI do science properly.

How to apply


Apply online through the link here: https://airtable.com/appZKkV7FT7eYBhKI/shrjJ3jYfxZjsNckR

It takes about 30 minutes: a few practical questions, four short written answers, links to your code, and your CV or personal website. No cover letter needed.

Applications close on Monday 16 November 2026, 23:59 CET.

We read every application after the deadline and reply to everyone.

About Sodalis

Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait.

Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist.

We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx).

Â 

The Opportunity

Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own.
We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live.

We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range.
You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture.

  • Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between.

  • Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy.

  • Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site.

  • Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering.

  • You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services.

  • You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded.

  • You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them.

  • You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity.

We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. jobs.title: Scientific Account Executive
jobs.description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. Weâre growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the role This is a hybrid sales and customer success role for someone with real scientific depth. You'll be the primary point of contact for customers â from first conversation through ongoing engagement. That means understanding what a protein design team is actually trying to achieve, helping them pick the right assays, making sure their experiments are set up correctly, and translating results back into language that's useful for their programs. The day-to-day: Running technical sales calls where you discuss binding kinetics, expression systems, and assay design, not just pricing Onboarding new customers and helping them design their first experiments on the platform Monitoring ongoing accounts, flagging issues early, and proactively suggesting next steps based on their results Working with the biology team to troubleshoot when a customer's experiment doesn't go as expected Identifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts â new targets, new assay types, larger campaigns You won't be handed a script. You'll need to understand the science well enough to earn trust from PhD-level protein engineers and CSOs, while also being commercially sharp enough to close deals and grow accounts. Responsibilities Own the full customer lifecycle: prospecting, technical sales conversations, deal closing, onboarding, and ongoing account management. Serve as the technical point of contact for customers. Understand their protein engineering goals and recommend the right experiments (binding, expression, thermostability, enzyme activity). Understand and explain our assay capabilities in depth: BLI, SPR, cell-free expression, and emerging assay types. Know when each is appropriate and what the data means. Work closely with the biology team to ensure experiments are designed correctly and results are communicated clearly. Build and maintain a pipeline of commercial opportunities across customer segments: AI-driven protein design companies, biotech startups, pharma R&D teams, and academic labs. You will be the point of contact for your areas during the close and the annual audit. Over time, your responsibilities may expand into other areas of the close as the business and team grow.

You will also help build scalable, efficient processes that support Plaidâs growth and public readiness. This includes documenting and strengthening controls in your areas, shortening the close, improving the quality and consistency of supporting documentation, and identifying opportunities to automate manual work. You will partner with the broader Accounting team, FP&A, Strategic Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Marketing, and external auditors along the way.

Responsibilities

  • Own the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close for accruals, investments, leases, intercompany activity and cost allocations, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and variance analysis.

  • Prepare and maintain intercompany and consolidation entries across Plaidâs entities, including cost-plus arrangements and FX revaluation and elimination.

  • Partner with FP&A, Strategic Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Marketing, and vendors to ensure spend is accrued completely and accurately and that balances are well understood.

  • Identify and implement process, automation, and control improvements in your areas to shorten the close and support SOX 404 readiness.

  • Serve as the primary contact for your areas during the annual audit, preparing support and responding to auditor requests.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, including Big 4 public accounting, with a deep understanding of US GAAP; CPA preferred.

  • Experience at a public company or with IPO readiness

  • Familiarity with SOX compliance and the ability to produce audit-ready workpapers;

  • Experience with multi-entity, multi-currency accounting;

  • Proficiency with NetSuite, Zip, T&E and close management platforms is a plus

  • Problem solver and first-principles thinker with a bias for action, creativity, and a willingness to challenge conventional approaches.

  • Curious, fast learner with a growth mindset who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

  • Hands-on, can-do attitude, willing to roll up their sleeves, dive into details, and own execution.

  • Proven change agent with a track record of improving processes, leveraging technology, and scaling operations.

  • Strong communicator and collaborator who can effectively engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!

Plaid is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ethnicity, religion or religious belief, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, military or veteran status, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Plaid is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance with your application or interviews due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations@plaid.com.

Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here.

Additional compensation in the form(s) of equity and/or commission are dependent on the position offered. Plaid provides a comprehensive benefit plan, including medical, dental, vision, and 401(k). Pay is based on factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience and skillset, and location. Pay and benefits are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefit plans.

jobs.title: Graduate Transport Planner
jobs.description:
At Curtins, we're an employee-owned engineering consultancy driven by a simple ambition: to create a better built environment for everyone.

For over 65 years, we've delivered practical, innovative and sustainable solutions that make a positive impact on communities across the UK and Ireland. From major regeneration schemes and commercial developments to education, healthcare and residential projects, our work helps shape the places where people live, learn, work and thrive.

As a Graduate Transport Planner, you'll work alongside experienced planners, engineers and consultants, contributing to a wide range of projects while developing the technical and professional skills you need to build your career.

Whether you're interested in transport assessments, active travel & sustainable mobility, highways or public transport, we'll give you the experience, guidance and support to find the areas that interest you most and develop your expertise in development planning.

What you'll be doing

You will support the planning and development process, helping clients bring projects forward from initial concept through to planning approval.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Assisting with the preparation of Transport Assessments and Transport Statements.

  • Supporting the production of Travel Plans and technical planning reports.

  • Analysing traffic, transport and movement data.

  • Assisting with junction assessments and development impact studies.

  • Supporting planning applications for residential, commercial and mixed-use developments.

  • Working alongside planners, civil engineers and other specialists to deliver integrated solutions.

  • Attending client meetings, project discussions and stakeholder consultations.

  • Taking part in wider Curtins activities including STEM outreach, charity initiatives and community projects.

What kind of projects will I get to work on?

You'll be involved in projects across a wide range of sectors, including:

  • Residential developments.

  • Urban regeneration schemes.

  • Commercial and industrial projects.

  • Education and healthcare developments.

  • Mixed-use masterplans.

  • Strategic land and development opportunities.

You'll help assess how developments interact with the transport network and support clients through the planning process, helping turn ideas into deliverable projects.

How will Curtins support my development?

Our goal is simple: to help you become the best engineer you can be.

Through the Curtins Graduate Academy, you'll follow a structured development programme designed to accelerate both your technical and professional growth.

You'll benefit from:

  • A structured graduate development programme.

  • Dedicated mentoring and coaching.

  • Regular technical and professional skills training.

  • Support towards professional registration and Chartership.

  • Exposure to a wide range of projects, clients and sectors.

  • Opportunities to build your network across the business.

You'll be supported by experienced professionals who are genuinely invested in your success and development.

What we're looking for

We're looking for graduates who are curious, analytical and interested in how development projects are planned and delivered.

You'll ideally be studying towards or have recently completed a degree in:

  • Transport Planning

  • Geography

  • Urban Planning

  • Civil Engineering

  • Town Planning

  • Geography or a related discipline

It would also be advantageous to hold an MSc in Transport Planning, Transport Engineering, Urban Planning, or Development Planning.

Most importantly, we're looking for people who share our values:

Integrity - Doing the right thing.

Being Human - Supporting and respecting others.

Curiosity - Asking questions and seeking better solutions.

Impact - Making a meaningful difference through our work.

Why join Curtins?

As an employee-owned business, every person at Curtins contributes to and benefits from our success.

Alongside exciting projects and a supportive culture, you'll enjoy:

  • Industry-leading benefits package.

  • Award-winning training and development programmes.

  • Employee ownership benefits.

  • Opportunities to get involved in STEM, charity and community initiatives.

  • Access to our unique Employee Extras, including our 5-star holiday lodges.

Most importantly, you'll be joining a business where your ideas matter, your development is supported and your contribution makes a real difference.

Build your future with Curtins.

Should you wish to discuss any adjustments to the application process or provide us with feedback please contact hr@curtins.com we would be happy to discuss ways we can make the process more suitable to your needs.

We value diversity and respect all differences in people. We invite enthusiastic individuals who share in our values of teamwork, client focus, integrity, and quality to apply to join us.

raw_payload.description:
About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

  • Tailwind CSS

  • HTML

  • HTTP

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

How to Apply

 

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

raw_payload.description:
Important: Applications without an intro video will not be considered.


Job Overview

Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media.


About us

Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.

We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.

We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.


What you'll do
  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
  • Write video scripts and outlines.
  • Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.
  • Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor.


What we're looking for
  • Native-level written and spoken English
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently
  • Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners
  • Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it
  • AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to producing high-quality work
  • Ability to take feedback and continuously improve
  • Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects
  • Genuine interest in YouTube, online tools, software, and learning new topics
  • A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
  • Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
  • Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada


Nice to have
  • Previous experience creating educational video content
  • Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about
  • Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos


Working at Metics Media

At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. We're a small, ambitious team with high standards, and we're always looking for ways to improve what we create and how we work.

At the same time, you'll get hands-on support, feedback, and training from people with over 8 years of experience making YouTube videos.


Compensation
  • Base salary: $70,000 USD per year (US) / CA$80,000 per year (Canada)
  • Profit sharing: Earn a percentage of the profit generated by every video you create, paid out quarterly
  • For reference, our current creators have earned an average total compensation (base salary + profit-sharing bonuses) of $85,000 USD in their first year and $155,000 USD in their second year. These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed.


Benefits
  • 15 days of paid vacation per year, plus public holidays
  • 10 paid sick days per year
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • A 401(k) with employer contributions (US)


How to apply

Applications require a short intro video (max. 5 minutes) and your CV. Click "Apply" for all details.

This is a hands-on, mid-level individual contributor role for an engineer who is strong in React, TypeScript and Next.js, has the visual judgment to make what they build look right without every state being specified, and uses AI tooling as an everyday part of how they work. Direction comes from the team; execution and craft are yours. The role reports to the Sr. Manager, UX/UI & Digital Experience. Work hands-on in the shared component library every week: build new components, extend existing ones, and improve what is there through cleaner APIs, better typing and clearer documentation, and help shape where it goes next. Build for front-end performance across the site, including Core Web Vitals. Build and improve the conversion and demo-request journey and the form experience. Build WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility into components and pages from the start, including automated accessibility checks. Write component and end-to-end tests for your own work. When you see a better way to do something — a pattern, an interaction, a page that should work differently — prototype it far enough that the team can react to a working example. Use AI tooling, including Claude and Claude Code, as a core part of how you design, build, test and review, and help shape how the team uses it. Build AI-powered features into the site as the team takes them on, such as assistive and conversational search, and content recommendation and personalization. Follow secure development practices: handle secrets properly, keep dependencies current, validate input at boundaries, and take part in standing security review. What You’ll Bring 3+ years shipping production React and TypeScript , working in TypeScript strict mode. Solid working knowledge of Next.js App Router, including server versus client components, rendering and caching, and the interest to go deeper. Experience building against a headless CMS or API-driven content, including querying over GraphQL, and building components that hold up when content does something unexpected. Strong CSS, including a utility-first framework, and an eye for layouts that hold together at every breakpoint. Experience working in a shared component library, and opinions about what makes one good to build with. Experience measuring and improving front-end performance. Experience testing your own work with component and end-to-end tests, including accessibility checks. Working knowledge of accessibility implementation: semantics, focus management and keyboard interaction. Good visual judgment and comfort in Figma: able to take design direction and fill in the gaps — spacing, states, responsive behavior — without needing every case specified. Everyday, specific use of AI tooling in your own workflow, with examples you can walk through. Comfort taking a piece of work from brief to shipped in a small team. Nice To Have Experience with a modern hosting and edge platform, including caching and revalidation, incremental regeneration, and debugging production builds. Experience building marketing and go-to-market web experiences, such as campaigns, launches and landing pages. Experience contributing to the design or evolution of a component library, not just building in one. Experience with Claude, Claude Code or comparable AI-assisted development tooling in a team setting. Experience building LLM-backed features, such as retrieval, prompt design and evaluation. Serverless or edge function work behind a front end, such as form handling, API routes and third-party integrations. Motion and animation implemented in code. As a trusted advisor to our sales organization and a key voice into Product, Risk, Engineering, Marketing, and CS, Solutions Consultants ensure our growth is grounded in strong technical alignment between Forter's AI-powered trust platform and the complex, evolving needs of the world's largest, fastest-growing digital businesses.

In Emerging Markets specifically, you'll also own the feedback loop that turns field experience into a sharpened go-to-market strategy: surfacing what you're seeing on the ground, forming a point of view on where to prioritize, and helping the business run rapid, repeatable experiments toward revenue outcomes.

We are looking to speak with candidates who bring a strong technical sales background, deep AI/ML fluency, and the presence to operate credibly with both technical and business leadership at large, complex organizations, including in markets where the playbook isn't written yet.

What you’ll be doing:

In this role, you will work on complex, high-stakes opportunities where analysis of a prospect's data, models, and architecture requires deep technical evaluation, and where your on-the-ground observations directly shape how Forter approaches an entire market. You will:

    • Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Lead technical discovery with prospects' data science, engineering, and risk teams to understand their existing models, data infrastructure, and decisioning logic, and design how Forter's platform integrates with and improves upon them
    • AI/ML Credibility & Value Translation: Engage as a domain-credible peer to prospects' AI/ML and data teams, then translate that technical depth into a clear, quantified business impact narrative for executive and business stakeholders
    • Market Data Capture & GTM Intelligence: Systematically capture market and technical discovery data across your Emerging Markets deals (buyer maturity, competitive landscape, technical objections, regulatory nuance, integration patterns) and turn it into an honed point of view on GTM prioritization and feasibility for internal teams
    • Sales Partnership: Partner with Sales Executives to drive account strategy, opportunity qualification, and pipeline generation, owning all technical aspects of the sales cycle: discovery, demos, proof of value, RFP/security responses, and technical closing
    • Executive & Business Stakeholder Engagement: Build trusted relationships across both technical (CTO/CPO org) and business-side stakeholders (Ecommerce teams, revenue business owners), positioning Forter as a strategic partner to the whole business, not just a point solution for IT
    • Cross-Functional Feedback Loops: Serve as a connective layer between the field and internal teams (Product, Risk, Engineering, Marketing, and CS), surfacing prospect and market feedback quickly and repeatably, and helping design experiments that convert field learning into revenue outcomes in a repeatable way
    • Customer Success Handoff: Ensure a clean, well-documented technical handoff to CS/Implementation post-sale, setting new customers up for long-term success
    • Innovation and Improvement: Continuously identify opportunities to improve Forter's platform, tooling, and sales process, and mentor other members of the Solutions Consulting team
    • Personal Training and Development: Stay current on evolving fraud, payments, and AI/ML landscape trends, as well as Forter's expanding product suite

What you’ll need:

    • 8+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, with 5+ years specifically in pre-sales/solutions consulting, sales engineering, or a similar technical sales capacity at enterprise software companies
    • A strong Data Science and/or Data Analytics background, with hands-on experience building, evaluating, or deploying AI/ML models
    • Demonstrated ability to work directly with AI/ML and data science teams at prospect organizations, able to speak their language, earn technical credibility, and translate model performance and architecture into business impact for less technical stakeholders
    • A track record of selling into large, highly complex organizations, ideally with experience navigating multi-stakeholder, multi-threaded enterprise sales cycles
    • Preferred experience selling into the CTO/CPO organization, as well as engaging directly with business-side personas (Ecommerce teams and the revenue business owners that CTO/CPO orgs ultimately need to support), so that technical evaluation stays tied to commercial outcomes
    • Comfort operating in ambiguity and building structure where none exists, with a genuine curiosity about new and emerging markets and the ability to synthesize scattered market signals into a clear, actionable point of view
    • Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to move fluidly between deep technical conversations and executive-level business narratives
    • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Risk, Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, and Sales to build rapid, repeatable feedback mechanisms between the field and internal teams
    • The ability to travel as needed to support the Emerging Markets territory
    • A Bachelor's degree in a technical or quantitative field (Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or related), or equivalent work experience
  • You may also have:
    • Experience in fraud prevention, payments, or e-commerce risk, highly beneficial, though secondary to AI/ML modeling depth and technical sales experience
    • Experience with modern data science tooling and languages (e.g. Python, SQL, R) and ML frameworks
    • Familiarity with real-time decisioning systems, transaction risk scoring, or similar high-throughput, low-latency architectures
    • Understanding of popular sales methodologies/frameworks such as MEDDPICC / Command of the Message
    • Prior experience opening up or scaling a new market or territory for a technology company, including building GTM point of view from limited data

About Us:

Commerce is evolving faster than the systems built to support it. Agentic AI is redrawing how people buy. Customer expectations have a new ceiling. And bad actors are evolving alongside every advancement. 

Forter was built to meet this moment — and stay ahead of it.

We are a human-first, AI-built company. Our technology analyzes patterns across a network of over 2 billion shoppers, delivering identity intelligence across the entire commerce journey — from sign-up to checkout to returns — that protects revenue and unlocks great customer experiences simultaneously. With Forter, businesses know who to trust, whether it’s humans or the agents shopping for them. The result: zero friction for the customers who matter. No revenue left behind.

The world's most trusted brands — Nordstrom, Instacart, Priceline, Adobe, ASOS, and eBay among them — rely on Forter to get this right. Since 2013, we've raised $525M from investors including Tiger Global, Bessemer, Sequoia Capital, and Salesforce Ventures, and today we power commerce decisions for nearly 1 million businesses globally. We're more than fraud, payments and orchestration – we make trust a competitive advantage.

Trust is backed by data –  Forter is a recipient of over 10 workplace and innovation awards, including: 

  • Great Place to Work Certification (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025)
  • Fortune’s Best Workplaces in NYC (2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025)
  • Forbes Cloud 100 (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025)

Life as a Forterian:

That's not an accident — it's something we've been intentional about since day one, and it's the thing people mention most when they talk about why they stay. When you're surrounded by people like this, doing work that actually matters, it changes what a job can feel like.

AI is core to our workflows — not as a shortcut, but as a force multiplier that gives Forterians the space to focus their energy where human judgment is irreplaceable.

We're a global team of 500+ people, with regional headquarters in New York, Tel Aviv, London, and Singapore, and employee presence across the US, Canada, Germany, France, Japan, China, and Australia. You'll have real ownership here and proximity to decisions. And we back that with investment in your growth — RSU offerings, L&D programs built around AI tools, and a culture of recognition rooted in our 4.5 day weeks (aka Forter’s Appreciation Fridays and Sundays). From team outings to local cultural celebrations, we mark the moments that matter — wherever you are in the world. We don't want Forter to be just another job. We want it to be the place you build.

If you're ready to work on a problem that sits at the intersection of AI, commerce, and human trust, this is it.

The Role We’re hiring a Bilingual/Spanish Speaking Clinical Navigator (Medical Assistant) to deliver virtual chronic care support for Medicare patients enrolled in Cadence care programs. Clinical Navigators deliver proactive, patient-centered outreach and follow-through. Depending on program needs, this role includes structured patient check-ins, coaching and goal-setting, care coordination to close gaps in care, and addressing barriers such as access to resources, transportation, or medication refills. Clinical Navigators document patient interactions in the Cadence platform and collaborate closely with the clinical team to escalate concerns and coordinate next steps, ensuring patients feel supported, informed, and engaged throughout their care journey. Schedule This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States. Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, from 8am to 5pm or 9am to 6pm in your local time zone. Help patients execute personalized care plans and achieve their goals by providing education and coaching focused on behavior modification, nutrition, physical activity, and self-management strategies using evidence-based techniques such as motivational interviewing and SMART goals. Conduct comprehensive assessments of patients' health status, lifestyle behaviors, nutritional habits, and readiness to change. Educate patients on disease management, medication adherence, symptom recognition, and prevention strategies, and execute care delivery tasks in accordance with Cadence clinical policies and established protocols, under appropriate clinical supervision. Monitor patients' progress, adherence to treatment plans, and health outcomes through regular check-ins and remote monitoring tools. Document patient interactions, outcomes, and follow-up plans in the Cadence platform; identify barriers to care (including social needs) and connect patients with resources or internal support pathways. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management. Comfortable using AI-assisted clinical tools (such as Gemini or Open Evidence) to support patient interactions and surface relevant clinical context, while maintaining clinical judgment as the primary guide for every patient decision. Biased toward action - you bring clinical authority to every interaction, make the call when it counts, and take ownership of outcomes. jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease. Its Clinical Intelligence takes on the routine, high-volume work of chronic care – monitoring patients, surfacing risks, and coordinating action – so clinicians can focus on the decisions that require them. Grounded in partnerships with more than 20 leading health systems, deep EMR integrations, dedicated medical group, and experience serving a population of more than 100,000 patients, the system learns from real-world care delivery, improving as it scales. Cadence has been recognized by TIME as one of the Top 100 HealthTech Companies and by LinkedIn as a Top Startup (#4, 2025). We're hiring a Licensed Practical/Vocational Nurse (LPN/LVN) to monitor a panel of remotely enrolled patients and move the ones who need clinical attention into care the same day. You will review incoming vitals and symptom data for patients with hypertension, heart failure, and diabetes, working alongside Cadence nurses and nurse practitioners to act on risk between visits. This role sits inside Cadence's Clinical Intelligence workflows, where alerts are surfaced continuously and licensed clinicians decide what happens next. Schedule: Four 10-hour day shifts per week with every-other-weekend coverage required. Workdays and shift start times are assigned based on coverage needs within your designated shift. Your first scheduling cycle will be assigned. For subsequent cycles, you may submit preferred workdays; preferences are considered but not guaranteed, and scheduled days may vary by cycle. Training: The first two weeks follow a Monday–Friday, eight-hour-per-day schedule. The following 1-2 weeks align with your preceptor’s schedule before you transition to your regular schedule upon successful completion of training. What You'll Do Monitor incoming vital signs, symptoms, and health indicators for a panel of patients enrolled in Cadence remote monitoring. Triage alerts and abnormal readings against established clinical criteria and identify patients who require immediate clinical intervention. Contact patients with out-of-range readings to gather additional clinical information and confirm symptom, medication, and adherence context. Coordinate with Cadence nurses and nurse practitioners to route flagged patients into the right intervention and close the loop on every follow-up. Inspect AI-surfaced screening output and AI-drafted documentation for clinical accuracy before it reaches a provider, correcting anything the model gets wrong. Document every patient interaction in the clinical record and build care summaries that give primary care providers and cardiologists a clear picture of what happened between visits. About CircleCI Engineering

CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them.

At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here.

We don't hire for a team. We hire for CircleCI. Where you land depends on where your strengths create the most leverage, and we figure that out together. You might own the CI pipeline experience, deploy and release tooling, notification infrastructure, monetization flows, AI agent surfaces, or the foundational web platform. The through line across all of it is the same: full-stack ownership, a high bar for craft, and work that directly shapes how tens of thousands of developers experience CircleCI every day.

What You'll Do

  • Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved.
  • Own technical strategy for your domain. You decide when and how the architecture evolves, balancing technical debt against velocity. When a project spans teams, you're the one who breaks down the ambiguity and takes ownership of whether it lands.
  • Invent new interfaces. Software delivery is being reinvented. Pipelines run autonomously, generate fixes, and surface results that need human judgment. The tools developers use to understand, trust, and act on that work don't exist yet. You'll define what they look like and establish the patterns the team builds on.
  • Own the full stack, at scale. Build features end-to-end in Go, React, and TypeScript. Your ownership extends past your own code to the systems and teams around it.
  • Connect engineering to the business. Partner directly with Product and Engineering Management to translate business goals into technical strategy. You understand the "why" behind the roadmap and use it to make tradeoffs.
  • Champion observability. Drive monitoring and alerting strategy across your domain, not just your own services. Use Honeycomb, Datadog, and Rollbar to reduce noise and improve the org's ability to diagnose problems quickly.
  • Mentor at scale. Mentor multiple engineers at once. Build the systems and documentation that transfer knowledge and remove single points of failure, not just your own.

What You'll Bring

  • AI-native engineering practices. You use AI tools daily and can speak to what you've built, where they changed your approach, and where they fall short.

A central part of this role is translating product change into field readiness: helping teams understand how new capabilities work, where they create value, and how to apply that knowledge in customer conversations. You will also help teams make effective use of the tools and resources already available to them through practical guidance, coaching, and reinforcement. Establish shared knowledge where it helps, while tailoring learning to each team’s responsibilities. Own the roadmap as a strategic advisor. Take in competing requests from post-sales leaders, prioritize them, and present an FY28 enablement roadmap rather than taking orders. Recognize when a need calls for a process fix, such as a RevOps change, instead of training. Turn product launches into readiness. Partner with Product and technical experts to understand new capabilities, use cases, implementation considerations, and limitations. Create learning experiences, demonstrations, and resources that help teams apply that knowledge with customers. Connect product capabilities to customer value. Work with Product Marketing to equip teams to explain outcomes and differentiation to both business and technical audiences. Develop customer-facing skills. ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS Be accountable for the technical health, scalability, and long-term sustainability of a defined infrastructure domain or platform area. Lead complex, multi-cycle infrastructure initiatives with end-to-end ownership — from problem framing and architecture design through to measurable delivery and stabilization. Design robust, scalable, and resilient infrastructure architectures and implementation plans that reduce operational risk and improve platform performance. Collaborate closely with Engineering Managers, Product, and cross-functional teams to align infrastructure work with business priorities and engineering roadmaps. Improve platform reliability by proactively identifying systemic risks, technical debt, and architectural bottlenecks within the domain and drive remediation before they impact teams or customers. Improve monitoring, observability, and incident response practices within your domain — contributing to better detection, root cause analysis, and long-term remediation. Raise engineering standards through thoughtful code and design reviews, documentation, and technical guidance. Mentor mid-level and senior engineers across the Infrastructure pillar, supporting their growth toward greater technical ownership. Support production stability by actively participating in debugging, root cause analysis, and long-term remediation efforts. Act as a technical reference point within a defined infrastructure domain, fostering alignment and reducing cross-team friction. Demonstrate AI literacy by actively applying AI tools to improve infrastructure workflows and drive measurable productivity gains across the team. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE 9+ years of relevant experience as a DevOps, Infrastructure, or Site Reliability Engineer, with demonstrated ownership of complex systems or subsystems. Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures, including compute platforms such as ECS, EKS, Fargate, Lambda or equivalents. Strong Linux fundamentals, networking, and fluency in scripting languages such as Bash, Ruby, Python, or Go. Experience with PostgreSQL operations and familiarity with caching and queueing systems such as Redis or Sidekiq. Strong experience with observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry, Datadog), SLOs, and incident response practices. Proven ability to apply zero-downtime deployments, autoscaling, and capacity planning in production environments. Strong knowledge of security best practices, including IAM, secrets management, network segmentation, and vulnerability management. Hands-on experience with cloud security and vulnerability management platforms (such as Aikido, Snyk, or Wiz), including triage, remediation workflows, and integration into CI/CD. Familiarity with supporting modern AI/ML services or data-intensive workflows is desirable. Excellent knowledge of how to identify and fix performance bottlenecks across compute, storage, and network layers. AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional (or equivalent) is a strong plus. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to operate effectively in complex, evolving environments. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in a collaborative, remote-first setting. Headquarters: Remote Canada | Remote United States

BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

The Role

As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you are responsible for turning our largest customers’ BeyondTrust investment into outcomes they can measure. You own the path from purchase to outcome: agreeing what success looks like with the customer’s executive sponsors and driving adoption of the solution across their teams so those outcomes are achieved and value is realised. You keep your accounts healthy and identify and mitigate risk early, building the proven value that gives the account team a strong footing to renew and grow every account. You are a trusted advisor to security and IT leadership, helping them get the most from their investment. 

What You’ll Do

  • Value realisation: Agree measurable business outcomes and success criteria with each customer. Baseline them, track progress, and report evidence of value delivered. 
  • Success plans: Build and run outcome-based success plans for every account in your book, covering each stage of the customer journey with clear milestones and owners on both sides. Track progress against the plan and escalate where delivery is off course. 
  • Adoption and time to value: Drive adoption of purchased capability against entitlement, using usage data to find where value is going unrealised. Work with the customer’s teams to improve how they use the product and close the gap early. 
  • Account health and risk management: Own the health of your accounts. Monitor usage, sentiment, engagement and delivery signals to identify risk early and diagnose the cause. Own the remediation plan, collaborating cross-functionally to make sure actions are created with named owners, tracked, and closed on time. Keep risks, actions and progress visible to the account team. 
  • Executive engagement: Lead success reviews with sponsors that cover outcomes achieved, usage, risk and roadmap fit, and build ROI cases the customer can use internally. 
  • Account team partnership: Share health, risk and value insights with Sales and Renewals so they go into renewal and expansion conversations with a clear picture of the account. Flag where realised value or new customer needs point to opportunity, and hand these to the account team to pursue. 
  • Escalations: Lead the cross-functional response to escalated customer issues and manage executive-level escalations to resolution. 
  • Cross-team coordination: Work with Services, Education, Technical Account Management, Support, Solution Engineers, Sales and Renewals so that delivery, technical issues and commercial activity all support the customer’s success plan. 
  • Voice of the customer and advocacy: Surface feedback and feature requests to Product with business context, and develop referenceable customers and case studies. 
  • Product Knowledge: Develop and maintain a strong understanding of BeyondTrust’s solutions, applying product knowledge to guide customers toward successful adoption, value realization and outcomes.   

What You’ll Bring

  • 2+ years in customer success, technical account management or a similar post-sale role, managing enterprise customers.
  • A track record of driving product adoption and demonstrating measurable customer outcomes.
  • Experience building and running success plans and using health scoring and usage data to identify and mitigate account risk.
  • Experience leading success reviews and building credibility with senior stakeholders.
  • Experience managing escalations and de-escalating customer concerns, driving cross-functional actions through to resolution.
  • Ability to manage a portfolio of strategic accounts and prioritise effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including translating technical detail into business value.
  • A proactive approach: anticipating risk and acting before issues escalate.

Nice To Have

  • Cybersecurity experience, ideally privileged access management or identity security and knowledge of BeyondTrust products.
  • Background in customer success, technical customer success, technical presales, technical account management or professional services.
  • Awareness of cybersecurity and software trends.
  • Experience with Salesforce, Gainsight and Microsoft Office.

Better Together

Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

About Us

BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.

BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.

Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com.

Headquarters: Remote - US: Select locations

Role Description

As part of the Product Security Engineering team, you’ll focus on reducing risk at scale by building the security infrastructure, automation, and tooling that empowers engineers to ship secure products with confidence. We work closely with engineering and product teams throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), embedding secure-by-default practices and delivering scalable solutions.

Product Security Engineers create impact by implementing security tooling, writing custom security rules, and building frameworks that address broad classes of vulnerabilities. In addition to proactive development, we support teams through threat modeling, documentation, and education to uplift security culture across Dropbox.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain security tools, automation, and libraries to enable secure-by-default development across engineering teams.
  • Design and implement custom security rules (e.g., Semgrep, CodeQL) to detect and prevent common and emerging vulnerability patterns.
  • Act as a subject matter expert on application security across web, mobile, and desktop environments.
  • Improve and scale the Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC) by integrating tools, checks, and processes into engineering workflows.
  • Perform targeted code reviews, and develop follow-up tooling or controls to prevent regressions.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, GRC, and AI/ML teams to proactively address security risks, especially in fast-moving and emerging tech areas.

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in application security or security engineering roles.
  • Hands-on experience building or using security automation tools to improve developer workflows and product security.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across the SDLC, including supporting and interpreting findings from penetration tests and bug bounty reports.
  • Familiarity with modern tech stacks, including microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native environments.
  • Solid understanding of common vulnerability classes (e.g., injection, XSS, authN/authZ issues) and practical mitigation strategies.
  • Comfortable working in cross-functional environments and supporting multiple product and engineering teams simultaneously.
  • Experience participating in or supporting incident response or security on-call rotations is a plus

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in application security engineering, with a strong focus on security tooling and automation.
  • Demonstrated ability to write and maintain custom security rules and integrate them into developer workflows.
  • Experience with machine learning systems, particularly generative AI, and the ability to support secure development in AI-driven products.
  • Experience developing internal libraries or frameworks that reduce or eliminate entire classes of vulnerabilities.
  • Proficient in software development, with experience contributing production-level code in one or more modern languages.
  • Familiarity with securing diverse application types, including web, mobile, and native platforms.
  • Experience with data security, including tooling for data protection, access control, and encryption.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to build trusted partnerships with cross-functional teams.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Compensation

This role is not available in Zone 1

US Zone 2
$193,500—$261,900 USD
US Zone 3
$172,000—$232,800 USD

jobs.title: Associate, Resource Management
jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote (US) ABOUT THE ROLE At Current, we're looking for an Associate, Staffing & Talent Operations to support day-to-day resource management, staffing coordination, and talent operations across our multidisciplinary agency. Reporting to the Director, Staffing & Talent Operations, this person will work closely with Production, Operations, and department leads to manage resource allocations, monitor team capacity, and ensure staffing plans are accurate and up to date. The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with Adobe Workfront , understands resource management within an agency environment, and is comfortable managing multiple staffing priorities. We're looking for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and able to keep teams aligned on who's working on what. WHAT YOU'LL DO Manage day-to-day resource allocations, staffing schedules, and project assignments in Adobe Workfront across active and upcoming projects. Participate in weekly departmental resourcing calls, documenting staffing decisions, allocation changes, and action items. Make real-time updates in Workfront during resourcing meetings and follow up to ensure all staffing changes are accurately reflected. Monitor team capacity, availability, and utilization across departments, including Creative, Strategy, Design, Production, and Technology. Partner with Production and department leads to understand project timelines, staffing needs, and upcoming resource requirements. Identify scheduling conflicts, resource gaps, and over- or under-allocation, escalating concerns and helping coordinate solutions. Track upcoming and TBD resource requests, following up with teams to ensure open staffing needs are addressed. Support short- and long-term resource forecasting, utilization reporting, and staffing documentation. Assist with freelance resource coordination, recruiting activities, candidate tracking, and maintaining talent pipelines. Help maintain accurate staffing data, improve resource management processes, and support Workfront best practices. WHAT YOU'LL NEED 2-4 years of experience in resource management, staffing operations, or a similar role, preferably within a digital or creative agency. Strong hands-on experience with Adobe Workfront is required , particularly resource planning, allocations, scheduling, and capacity management. Experience managing staffing and resource allocations across multiple projects, departments, or disciplines. Understanding of resource forecasting, utilization, project timelines, and staffing requirements. Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities. Ability to capture staffing decisions accurately and make system updates in real time. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working directly with producers, project managers, and department leads. Proactive problem-solving skills and the ability to identify staffing conflicts and follow through on next steps. Proficiency in Google Sheets or Excel for tracking, reporting, and maintaining staffing data. Experience supporting freelance staffing, recruiting coordination, or talent pipeline management is a plus. Familiarity with digital production workflows, project budgets, and scope management is a plus. WHY CURRENT At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact. We're a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates. You'll have the opportunity to work across multiple departments, help shape how we manage staffing and talent, and play an important role in supporting our teams as the agency continues to grow. The target hourly compensation range for this contract role is $30-$45 per hour. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location. This position is initially offered as maternity leave coverage, with the potential for conversion to a permanent role based on performance and business needs. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/current-associate-resource-management
